So, these are clients that are referred to our NoVA team at PEP intake. These DH’s applicants are referred to our team when they disclose that there’s been a history of DV or they’ve experienced DV. That’s the elephant in the room. The program managed by End NGBV provides low barrier grants to survivor and connects them to the supportive services with the goal of helping them maintain housing.
